body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Altec Lansing presented ''M604'', its new audio system designed for MS'' Zune mp3 player. It can serve to charge Zune and offers video out-put which enables users to watch video contents stored in Zune in large screen TV. A remote control is provided also.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
